_about: The pause menu's item, chapter and song text, written for this editor in our own words. Nothing here is copied from the game.

Item_DekuStick.name: Deku Stick
Item_DekuStick.caption: A dry branch. Swing it as a club or light it to carry a flame.

Item_StickBag_Small.name: Deku Stick Bag
Item_StickBag_Small.caption: A long pouch for carrying Deku Sticks.

Weapon_Range_SlingShot.name: Fairy Slingshot
Weapon_Range_SlingShot.caption: Fires Deku Seeds at distant switches and foes. Child only.

Item_BulletBag_Small.name: Bullet Bag (30)
Item_BulletBag_Small.caption: A pouch for slingshot seeds. Holds 30.

Item_MagicBean.name: Magic Beans
Item_MagicBean.caption: Plant one in soft soil as a child and it grows into a moving platform later.

Item_Boomerang.name: Boomerang
Item_Boomerang.caption: Thrown in a curve, it stuns foes and grabs far-off items. Child only.

Weapon_Range_Bow.name: Fairy Bow
Weapon_Range_Bow.caption: Shoots arrows at long range. Adult only.

Item_Arrow_Fire.name: Fire Arrow
Item_Arrow_Fire.caption: An arrow wrapped in flame that burns and melts what it hits. Uses magic.

Pouch_Range_BowAndArrow_Fire.name: Fire Arrow
Pouch_Range_BowAndArrow_Fire.caption: An arrow wrapped in flame that burns and melts what it hits. Uses magic.

Item_Arrow_Ice.name: Ice Arrow
Item_Arrow_Ice.caption: An arrow of frost that freezes foes solid. Uses magic.

Pouch_Range_BowAndArrow_Ice.name: Ice Arrow
Pouch_Range_BowAndArrow_Ice.caption: An arrow of frost that freezes foes solid. Uses magic.

Item_Arrow_Light.name: Light Arrow
Item_Arrow_Light.caption: A holy arrow that pierces dark magic. Uses magic.

Pouch_Range_BowAndArrow_Light.name: Light Arrow
Pouch_Range_BowAndArrow_Light.caption: A holy arrow that pierces dark magic. Uses magic.

Item_Hookshot.name: Hookshot
Item_Hookshot.caption: A spring-loaded chain that pulls you to wooden targets.

Item_Longshot.name: Longshot
Item_Longshot.caption: A hookshot with twice the reach.

Item_Hammer.name: Megaton Hammer
Item_Hammer.caption: A huge hammer for rusty switches, stubborn blocks and big foes. Adult only.

Item_Bomb.name: Bomb
Item_Bomb.caption: Light it, then get clear. Breaks cracked walls and rocks.

Item_Bombchu.name: Bombchu
Item_Bombchu.caption: A wind-up bomb that races along the ground and up walls.

Item_DekuNut.name: Deku Nut
Item_DekuNut.caption: Throw it to burst in a bright flash that stuns nearby foes.

Item_NutBag_Small.name: Deku Nut Bag
Item_NutBag_Small.caption: A woven bag for carrying Deku Nuts.

Item_ScrubBusinessSeed.name: Business Scrub Seed
Item_ScrubBusinessSeed.caption: A sprouting seed sold by the scrubs who run small shops.

Item_DinFire.name: Din's Fire
Item_DinFire.caption: A magic burst of flame that spreads out around you.

Item_FaroreWind.name: Farore's Wind
Item_FaroreWind.caption: Sets a warp point inside a dungeon and returns you to it later.

Item_NayruLove.name: Nayru's Love
Item_NayruLove.caption: A crystal barrier that blocks damage for a short time.

Armor_GlassTruth.name: Lenses of Truth
Armor_GlassTruth.caption: Tinted goggles that show what is hidden or false. Uses magic while worn.

Item_Ocarina_Fairy.name: Fairy Ocarina
Item_Ocarina_Fairy.caption: A simple wooden ocarina, a gift from a forest friend.

Pouch_Amiibo.name: amiibo
Pouch_Amiibo.caption: Bonus items from a scanned figure.

Item_Bottle.name: Empty Bottle
Item_Bottle.caption: Catch bugs, fish, fairies and more, or carry a drink.

Item_Bottle_Milk.name: Lon Lon Milk
Item_Bottle_Milk.caption: Fresh ranch milk. Two drinks, each restores some hearts.

Item_Bottle_Fairy.name: Fairy
Item_Bottle_Fairy.caption: Heals you when used, or saves you automatically if you fall.

Item_Bottle_Fish.name: Fish
Item_Bottle_Fish.caption: A small fish. Someone hungry may want it.

Item_Bottle_Bug.name: Bugs
Item_Bottle_Bug.caption: A few bugs. Let them go in soft soil to find what is hidden there.

Item_Bottle_BlueFire.name: Blue Fire
Item_Bottle_BlueFire.caption: A cold flame that melts red ice.

Item_Bottle_Poe.name: Poe
Item_Bottle_Poe.caption: A captured ghost. Someone may buy it.

Item_Bottle_BigPoe.name: Big Poe
Item_Bottle_BigPoe.caption: A large captured ghost, worth more to a collector.

Item_Bottle_Letter.name: Ruto's Letter
Item_Bottle_Letter.caption: A message in a bottle from the Zora princess.

Item_WeirdEgg.name: Weird Egg
Item_WeirdEgg.caption: A large egg. Keep it with you and see what hatches.

Item_AlarmCucco.name: Chicken
Item_AlarmCucco.caption: A loud bird that wakes up anyone who is asleep.

Item_ZeldaLetter.name: Zelda's Letter
Item_ZeldaLetter.caption: A note from the princess that vouches for you.

Item_PocketEgg.name: Pocket Egg
Item_PocketEgg.caption: A small egg that will hatch overnight.

Item_PocketCucco.name: Pocket Cucco
Item_PocketCucco.caption: A newly hatched bird with a very loud call.

Item_CojiroCucco.name: Cojiro
Item_CojiroCucco.caption: A rare blue bird that misses its owner.

Item_OddMushroom.name: Odd Mushroom
Item_OddMushroom.caption: A forest mushroom that spoils quickly. Deliver it fast.

Item_OddPowder.name: Odd Potion
Item_OddPowder.caption: A strong brew made from the mushroom.

Item_PoacherSaw.name: Poacher's Saw
Item_PoacherSaw.caption: A carpenter's saw left behind by its owner.

Item_BrokenSword.name: Broken Goron's Sword
Item_BrokenSword.caption: A famous blade, snapped in two. It needs a master smith.

Item_Prescription.name: Prescription
Item_Prescription.caption: A doctor's note naming a rare remedy.

Item_EyeballFrog.name: Eyeball Frog
Item_EyeballFrog.caption: A frog used to make medicine. Hurry before it spoils.

Item_EyeDrop.name: Eye Drops
Item_EyeDrop.caption: Strong drops for sore eyes. They lose their power fast.

Item_ClaimCheck.name: Claim Check
Item_ClaimCheck.caption: A ticket to collect a finished sword.

Weapon_Sword_Kokiri.name: Kokiri Sword
Weapon_Sword_Kokiri.caption: A short sword from the forest village. Child only.

Weapon_Sword_Master.name: Master Sword
Weapon_Sword_Master.caption: The legendary blade that repels evil. Adult only.

Weapon_Sword_Biggoron.name: Biggoron's Sword
Weapon_Sword_Biggoron.caption: A huge two-handed blade that never breaks.

Weapon_Sword_Giant.name: Giant's Knife
Weapon_Sword_Giant.caption: A heavy two-handed blade bought from a mountain merchant. It may not last.

Weapon_Sword_BrokenGiant.name: Broken Giant's Knife
Weapon_Sword_BrokenGiant.caption: The blade snapped. It can still be repaired.

Weapon_Shield_Deku.name: Deku Shield
Weapon_Shield_Deku.caption: A light wooden shield. It burns easily.

Weapon_Shield_Hylian.name: Hylian Shield
Weapon_Shield_Hylian.caption: A sturdy metal shield that fire cannot harm.

Weapon_Shield_Mirror.name: Mirror Shield
Weapon_Shield_Mirror.caption: A polished shield that reflects light and some magic.

Obj_Armor_Child_Normal.name: Kokiri Tunic
Obj_Armor_Child_Normal.caption: The green tunic of the forest people.

Armor_Adult_Normal.name: Hero's Clothes
Armor_Adult_Normal.caption: The green tunic, sized for an adult.

Armor_Adult_Goron.name: Goron Tunic
Armor_Adult_Goron.caption: A heat-proof tunic for scorching places.

Armor_Adult_HeavyBoot.name: Iron Boots
Armor_Adult_HeavyBoot.caption: Very heavy boots for walking along the bottom of deep water.

Armor_Adult_HoverBoot.name: Hover Boots
Armor_Adult_HoverBoot.caption: Let you walk on air for a moment, but give little grip.

Armor_Child_Mask_Keaton.name: Keaton Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Keaton.caption: A fox-like mask that some guards find delightful.

Armor_Child_Mask_Spooky.name: Spooky Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Spooky.caption: A gloomy mask that a certain child admires.

Armor_Child_Mask_Bunny.name: Bunny Hood
Armor_Child_Mask_Bunny.caption: Long-eared hood that puts a spring in your step.

Armor_Child_Mask_Goron.name: Goron Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Goron.caption: A round, friendly face of a mountain dweller.

Armor_Child_Mask_Zora.name: Zora Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Zora.caption: A fish-like face of a river dweller.

Armor_Child_Mask_Gerudo.name: Gerudo Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Gerudo.caption: The face of a desert woman, with bright red hair.

Armor_Child_Mask_Truth.name: Mask of Truth
Armor_Child_Mask_Truth.caption: Wear it to hear what the gossip stones are thinking.

Armor_Child_Mask_Amiibo0.name: Bonus Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Amiibo0.caption: A mask unlocked with a scanned figure.

Armor_Child_Mask_Amiibo1.name: Bonus Mask
Armor_Child_Mask_Amiibo1.caption: A mask unlocked with a scanned figure.

Item_AgonyStone.name: Echo Gem
Item_AgonyStone.caption: A green gem that hums and shakes when a secret is close by.

Item_Token_Gold.name: Gold Skulltula Token
Item_Token_Gold.caption: Proof of a cursed spider defeated. Collect them to lift a family's curse.

Obj_Heart_Piece.name: Piece of Heart
Obj_Heart_Piece.caption: Collect four to add a new heart.

Item_FairyBless_MP.name: Gift of Improved Spin
Item_FairyBless_MP.caption: A great fairy's blessing that charges your spin attack with power.

Item_FairyBless_MPDouble.name: Gift of Doubled Magic
Item_FairyBless_MPDouble.caption: A great fairy's blessing that doubles your magic meter.

Armor_Child_Gauntlet_Goron.name: Goron's Bracelet
Armor_Child_Gauntlet_Goron.caption: Lets a child pick up bomb flowers.

Armor_Adult_Gauntlet_Silver.name: Silver Gauntlets
Armor_Adult_Gauntlet_Silver.caption: Lift heavy stone blocks. Adult only.

Armor_Adult_Gauntlet_Gold.name: Golden Gauntlets
Armor_Adult_Gauntlet_Gold.caption: Lift even the largest pillars. Adult only.

Item_Token_Gerudo.name: Gerudo Membership Card
Item_Token_Gerudo.caption: Lets you pass freely through the desert fortress.

Meet_DekuTree.title: The Forest Calls
Meet_DekuTree.summary: A fairy finds a boy in the forest village and brings him to the old tree that watches over it.

Get_StoneOfForest.title: Inside the Old Tree
Get_StoneOfForest.summary: A curse is eating the guardian tree from within. Climb inside and end it.

Goto_HyruleCastle.title: A Visit to the Castle
Goto_HyruleCastle.summary: Sneak into the castle garden and meet the princess, who has a warning to share.

DoorOfTime.title: Three Stones
DoorOfTime.summary: Gather the three spiritual stones that open the sealed door.

Get_StoneOfFire.title: The Mountain Stone
Get_StoneOfFire.summary: Help the people of the mountain by clearing the cave that feeds them.

Get_StoneOfWater.title: The River Stone
Get_StoneOfWater.summary: Find the missing river princess inside a giant fish.

Get_Epona.title: A Horse to Ride
Get_Epona.summary: Win a horse of your own at the ranch.

SubEvent_GetMelodySun.title: Beneath the Graveyard
SubEvent_GetMelodySun.summary: Explore the royal tomb and learn a tune that changes day and night.

SubEvent_MaskSalesman.title: The Mask Shop
SubEvent_MaskSalesman.summary: Borrow masks from the shop in town and find each one a happy owner.

Meet_GreatFairy.title: Hidden Fountains
Meet_GreatFairy.summary: Seek out the fountains where great fairies grant new powers.

SubEvent_GetScarecrow.title: A Tune for a Scarecrow
SubEvent_GetScarecrow.summary: Teach a scarecrow by the lake a song of your own, then play it back years later.

SubEvent_GetStormSong.title: The Windmill Tune
SubEvent_GetStormSong.summary: Learn a stormy melody from the man in the village windmill.

AllSage.title: Awakening the Sages
AllSage.summary: Clear the temples and wake the sages who can seal away evil.

SageOfForest.title: Sage of the Forest
SageOfForest.summary: Clear the forest temple and wake its sage.

SageOfFire.title: Sage of Fire
SageOfFire.summary: Clear the fire temple and wake its sage.

SageOfWater.title: Sage of Water
SageOfWater.summary: Clear the water temple and wake its sage.

SageOfShadow.title: Sage of Shadow
SageOfShadow.summary: Clear the shadow temple and wake its sage.

SageOfSpirit.title: Sage of Spirit
SageOfSpirit.summary: Clear the spirit temple and wake its sage.

SubEvent_GetSwordBigGoron.title: A Sword for a Hero
SubEvent_GetSwordBigGoron.summary: Follow a long chain of trades to earn a great blade from the mountain smith.

Defeat_Ganon.title: The Final Battle
Defeat_Ganon.summary: Climb the dark tower and face the king of thieves.

songs.name: Zelda's Lullaby
songs.caption: A royal melody. Play it where the royal crest is shown.

songs.name: Epona's Song
songs.caption: Calls your horse and calms the cows.

songs.name: Saria's Song
songs.caption: A cheerful forest tune that lets you talk with a friend from afar.

songs.name: Sun's Song
songs.caption: Swaps day and night, and makes the restless dead stand still.

songs.name: Song of Time
songs.caption: Moves the blue time blocks out of your way.

songs.name: Song of Storms
songs.caption: Brings rain and can open hidden holes.

songs.name: Minuet of Forest
songs.caption: Warps you to the forest meadow.

songs.name: Bolero of Fire
songs.caption: Warps you into the volcano crater.

songs.name: Serenade of Water
songs.caption: Warps you to the lake shore.

songs.name: Requiem of Spirit
songs.caption: Warps you to the desert colossus.

songs.name: Nocturne of Shadow
songs.caption: Warps you to the village graveyard.

songs.name: Prelude of Light
songs.caption: Warps you to the temple at the heart of the land.

songs.name: Scarecrow's Song
songs.caption: Your own eight-note tune. Play it to call a helpful scarecrow.
